name: Allowance
description: Allowance is a payment security layer for AI agents. It lets Claude request a human-approved spending allowance, then use scoped virtual cards to complete purchases without exposing the user's real card. The connector supports approval requests, approval polling, contact and address retrieval for checkout, one-time virtual card issuance, remote fulfillment status, purchase result reporting, allowance management, and merchant capability checks. OAuth sign-in connects each Claude user to their own Allowance account. Allowance is designed for agent-initiated purchases that need clear spend limits, receipts, revocation, and an audit trail.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Allowance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Allowance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.useallowance.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Allowance MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Allowance lists 22 MCP tools, including cancel_allowance_request, check_merchant, complete_purchase_auth, get_allowance, get_allowance_billing_address, get_allowance_request, get_allowance_shipping_address, get_contact_details, issue_allowance_card, list_allowance_purchase_attempts, list_allowance_requests, and list_allowances.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Allowance?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Allowance in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Allowance requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Allowance is developed by Allowance. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
